$comment: Centralised contextual help. key -> {screen, label, short, extended?, docs?, kind, shortcut?}. kind: canonical = changes annotation data; view = temporary display state only; review = changes review state only; validation = recomputes/stores validation; navigation = moves/selects without changing data; destructive = removes canonical data (undoable unless stated). docs = help page name + optional #anchor.

project.create.label: Create project
project.create.short: Create a new project with its own class ontology and dataset pairs.

project.search.label: Search projects
project.search.short: Filter the project list by name as you type. Display only; nothing is changed.

project.open.label: Open
project.open.short: Open the project page with its datasets, classes and audit log.

project.delete.label: Delete project
project.delete.short: Move the whole project directory to the workspace trash. An administrator can restore it.

project.rename.label: Rename
project.rename.short: Change the project display name. Ids, datasets and classes are untouched.

project.import_pairs.label: Import images
project.import_pairs.short: Upload one image per channel (e.g. topography and friction); datasets are previewed before any is created.

project.import_xml.label: Import XML annotations
project.import_xml.short: Import legacy TSWAT / CVAT XML shapes as independent regions. Overlaps are preserved and start unreviewed.

project.export.label: Export
project.export.short: Open the export dialog. Only datasets validated at their current revision can be exported.

project.lock.label: Editing lock
project.lock.short: Shows which browser tab holds the editing lock. Other tabs open the project read-only.

project.system_status.label: System status
project.system_status.short: Show host resources, model backends and privacy state. Read-only.

project.theme.label: Theme
project.theme.short: Switch between the dark and light theme. Stored in this browser only.

project.help.label: Help
project.help.short: Open the local documentation (user guide, workflow, SAM, import/export, shortcuts). No network needed.

dataset.search.label: Search datasets
dataset.search.short: Filter the dataset list by original filename, pairing key, name or id (case-insensitive substring). Next/Previous in the workspace follow the filtered list while a filter is active.

dataset.search_clear.label: Clear filter
dataset.search_clear.short: Remove the dataset filter and show every dataset again.

dataset.annotate.label: Annotate
dataset.annotate.short: Open the annotation workspace for this dataset pair.

dataset.replace_source.label: Replace source
dataset.replace_source.short: Replace one channel's image after a compatibility check (same dimensions and calibration). Annotations are kept; validation becomes stale.

dataset.import_mask.label: Import mask
dataset.import_mask.short: Import a flattened label raster (PNG/TIFF) as regions. Lossy: original overlaps cannot be reconstructed.

dataset.delete.label: Delete dataset
dataset.delete.short: Move the dataset and its annotations to the workspace trash.

dataset.status_validated.label: validated
dataset.status_validated.short: The stored validation report matches the current dataset revision; the dataset can be exported.

dataset.status_blocked.label: blocked
dataset.status_blocked.short: The source pair has a problem (see the reason); the dataset cannot be validated or exported until it is fixed.

import.upload_preview.label: Upload and preview pairing
import.upload_preview.short: Upload the selected files and show how they pair. Nothing is committed until you confirm the preview.

import.allow_order.label: Pair by sorted order
import.allow_order.short: Fallback when no identifiers exist in the filenames: files are paired by sorted name order. You confirm the order is correct.

import.commit.label: Create datasets
import.commit.short: Create one dataset per OK pair; problem rows are skipped and listed.

import.pair_status.label: Dataset status
import.pair_status.short: OK rows can be created; a missing channel, ambiguous id, invalid file, dimension or calibration mismatch must be fixed first.

replace.check.label: Upload and check compatibility
replace.check.short: Upload the candidate and compare dimensions, calibration and checksum with the current image. Nothing is replaced yet.

replace.confirm.label: Confirm replacement
replace.confirm.short: Swap the source image. The dataset revision increases and the previous validation becomes stale.

xml.file.label: CVAT for images 1.1 XML
xml.file.short: The TSWAT/CVAT export. Images are matched to datasets by source filename; dimension mismatches are refused, never resampled.

xml.target_dataset.label: Target dataset
xml.target_dataset.short: Only for a single XML image that cannot be matched by filename: choose the dataset explicitly.

xml.stage.label: Upload and preview
xml.stage.short: Parse the XML and show image matches and label-to-class mapping. Nothing is imported yet.

xml.class_mapping.label: Class for XML label
xml.class_mapping.short: Map each XML label to an existing class, create a new class, or skip those shapes.

xml.commit.label: Import regions
xml.commit.short: Create one region per shape with full XML provenance. Every imported overlap starts unreviewed.

lossy.file.label: Label raster
lossy.file.short: Single-channel PNG/TIFF where 0 is unlabelled and every other value is a label. Must have the dataset's exact dimensions.

lossy.stage.label: Upload and preview values
lossy.stage.short: Decode the raster and list its values with pixel and component counts. The dimension check happens here; nothing is imported yet.

lossy.target_class.label: Target class
lossy.target_class.short: Class assigned to this raster value. Buffer is proposed when the project has a Buffer class; otherwise choose explicitly. 'Do not import this value' discards it only after confirmation.

lossy.split.label: One region per connected component
lossy.split.short: Each connected component becomes its own editable region; unticked, one region per value.

lossy.confirm_discard.label: Confirm discarded values
lossy.confirm_discard.short: Required before committing when any raster value is marked 'do not import'. Discarded pixels stay unlabelled.

lossy.commit.label: Import as lossy regions
lossy.commit.short: Create the regions (marked lossy_import, validation keeps warning), then open the workspace with them selected.

lossy.warning.label: Lossy import warning
lossy.warning.short: A flattened raster has already lost overlaps and hidden regions; they cannot be reconstructed. Prefer the XML import when the source annotation exists.

export.profile.label: Profile
export.profile.short: NanoUNet (default): Topography/Friction/Masks_instance layout verified against the downstream loader. Native exact: masks, regions, validation and sources for provenance.

export.mask_semantics.label: Mask values
export.mask_semantics.short: Value per pixel in the machine-readable mask: class export id (default) or a unique id per winning region.

export.boundary_policy.label: Boundary-class pixels
export.boundary_policy.short: Export Boundary-role pixels as their class value, or as 0 which the downstream evaluation ignores.

export.raster_format.label: Mask file format
export.raster_format.short: Container of the machine mask: uncompressed TIFF (loader default) or PNG. Values are identical uint16 scalars either way.

export.color_visualization.label: Colour visualisation
export.color_visualization.short: Also write mask_color.png: an RGB image of the same final composition using the exact class colours from the GUI, for viewing in any image viewer. The machine mask stays scalar.

export.search.label: Search datasets
export.search.short: Filter the export dataset list by name, original filename, pairing key or validation status.

export.select_all.label: Select all validated
export.select_all.short: Tick every dataset in the filtered list that is validated at its current revision.

export.dataset_row.label: Dataset
export.dataset_row.short: Only datasets validated at their current revision are exported; stale or never-validated ones are listed and skipped.

export.filename_preview.label: Filename preview
export.filename_preview.short: Names are derived from the original filenames (pairing key), sanitised, identical across Topography/Friction/Masks directories; the manifest records both names.

export.run.label: Create export
export.run.short: Compose, write and package the selected datasets. Export is derived data; the annotation is unchanged.

export.download.label: Download
export.download.short: Download the ZIP package of this export.

export.delete.label: Delete export
export.delete.short: Remove this export package from the workspace. Annotations are not affected.

class.name.label: Class name
class.name.short: Display name; must be unique. Identity is the numeric id and stable key, not the name.

class.color.label: Class colour
class.color.short: Display colour used on the canvas, in the Regions list and in the exported colour mask. Changing it never changes mask values.

class.stable_key.label: Stable key
class.stable_key.short: Machine identifier derived from the first name; never changes and is written into every export manifest.

class.role.label: Semantic role
class.role.short: MaterialLayer, Boundary or Unspecified. At most one enabled Boundary class; it is used by the Boundary policy and fill.

class.export_id.label: Export id
class.export_id.short: Value written into machine-readable masks for this class. Empty means the class id.

class.enabled.label: Enabled
class.enabled.short: Disabled classes are excluded from composition and cannot be assigned; regions still using one block validation.

class.delete.label: Delete class
class.delete.short: Remove the class. Refused while any region uses it; disable it instead.

class.add.label: Add class
class.add.short: Create a class with a new stable id. Available to every dataset of the project.

ws.back.label: Back to project
ws.back.short: Return to the project page. Pending autosaves are flushed first.

ws.prev_dataset.label: Previous dataset
ws.prev_dataset.short: Open the previous dataset. With a dataset filter active, moves within the filtered list.

ws.next_dataset.label: Next dataset
ws.next_dataset.short: Open the next dataset. With a dataset filter active, moves within the filtered list.

ws.undo.label: Undo
ws.undo.short: Revert the last edit, including Merge, Split, Subtract by Order and Delete Selected. The restored state is saved and validation becomes stale.

ws.redo.label: Redo
ws.redo.short: Re-apply the last undone edit with the identical result.

ws.save.label: Saved / Saving
ws.save.short: Autosave state. Every edit is saved as a new dataset revision; click to flush pending saves.

ws.validate.label: Validate
ws.validate.short: Recompute Findings for the current annotation revision and store the validation report that gates export. Does not change any region.

ws.export.label: Export
ws.export.short: Go to the project export dialog.

ws.backend.label: Backend
ws.backend.short: Segmentation model used for SAM proposals. Selecting a real model loads it on the server; unavailable backends state why.

ws.lock.label: Editing lock
ws.lock.short: Whether this tab may edit. Read-only sessions can look but not change anything.

ws.help.label: Help
ws.help.short: Open the local documentation in a new tab.

tool.select.label: Select
tool.select.short: Click a region on the canvas to select it; Ctrl+click adds or removes it from the selection.

tool.pan.label: Pan
tool.pan.short: Drag to move the view. Space+drag or middle mouse pans in any tool.

tool.polygon.label: Polygon
tool.polygon.short: Click vertices, Enter or double-click closes and creates a region of the active class. Shift+Enter adds to the selected region, Alt+Enter subtracts.

tool.brush.label: Brush
tool.brush.short: Paint pixels. Extends the selected region when it has the active class; otherwise the stroke creates a new region of the active class, also over existing or locked regions (the overlap becomes a Finding).

tool.eraser.label: Eraser
tool.eraser.short: Remove pixels from the selected region only. Locked regions are not erased.

tool.sam_positive.label: SAM positive point
tool.sam_positive.short: Add a point that must belong to the proposal. The model returns a proposal; nothing changes until you accept it.

tool.sam_negative.label: SAM negative point
tool.sam_negative.short: Add a point that must be excluded from the proposal.

tool.sam_box.label: SAM box prompt
tool.sam_box.short: Drag a box around the structure to segment. Points can refine the result.

tool.fit.label: Fit to view
tool.fit.short: Zoom so the whole image is visible. Display only.

tool.zoom_in.label: Zoom in
tool.zoom_in.short: Zoom the view in around the centre. Display only.

tool.zoom_out.label: Zoom out
tool.zoom_out.short: Zoom the view out around the centre. Display only.

tool.clear_selection.label: Clear selection
tool.clear_selection.short: Deselect every region and leave the edit context; the next brush stroke starts a new region of the active class. No region is changed or deleted.

polygon.finish.label: Finish polygon
polygon.finish.short: Close the polygon and create a region of the active class.

polygon.cancel.label: Cancel polygon
polygon.cancel.short: Discard the polygon vertices placed so far.

prompt.refine.label: Refine selected region
prompt.refine.short: Send the selected region as a mask prompt with your points/box (backends with mask prompts only). The region changes only if you accept the proposal.

prompt.text.label: Text prompt
prompt.text.short: Enter runs the concept detector for the typed text (backends with text prompts). Points cannot be combined with text.

proposal.variant.label: Proposal variant
proposal.variant.short: Choose between the proposal masks the model returned; the white overlay shows the current one.

proposal.accept.label: Accept as region
proposal.accept.short: Create a new region of the active class from the proposal, with model provenance recorded. Undoable.

proposal.add.label: Add to selected
proposal.add.short: Merge the proposal pixels into the selected region. Undoable.

proposal.reject.label: Reject
proposal.reject.short: Discard the proposal. Nothing was changed.

proposal.clear.label: Clear prompts
proposal.clear.short: Remove the placed points/box and any proposal. Nothing was changed.

class.active.label: Active class
class.active.short: Class given to new regions created by brush, polygon or accepted SAM proposals. Changing it never re-colours or reclassifies existing regions.

class.quick_add.label: Add class
class.quick_add.short: Create a class from the workspace and make it active.

class.item.label: Class
class.item.short: Click to make the class active. The number is the stable class id used in exports; the role tag marks Boundary classes.

status.coverage.label: Coverage
status.coverage.short: Share of pixels labelled after z-order composition. Click to open Findings.

status.missing.label: Missing
status.missing.short: Unlabelled pixels in the final composition. Click to highlight them and open Findings.

status.overlaps.label: Overlaps
status.overlaps.short: Overlap groups and how many are unreviewed. Click to open Findings.

status.validation.label: Validation
status.validation.short: State of the stored validation report: not run, valid at rN, stale (dataset changed since) or blocked.

status.resources.label: Host resources
status.resources.short: Live CPU, RAM, disk and GPU figures of the server; warnings when RAM or disk run low.

status.backend.label: Backend state
status.backend.short: Which segmentation backends are currently available.

regions.tab.label: Regions
regions.tab.short: All regions of the dataset, top of the list first. Higher rows win where regions overlap.

regions.row.label: Region row
regions.row.short: Click selects, Ctrl+click toggles, Shift+click selects a range, drag reorders z-order. A yellow left edge marks participation in an overlap.

regions.checkbox.label: Select region
regions.checkbox.short: Add or remove this region from the selection used by Merge checked, Subtract by Order and Delete Selected.

regions.class.label: Region class
regions.class.short: Reassign this region to another class. Geometry is unchanged; undoable.

regions.visible.label: Show / hide
regions.visible.short: Hidden regions are not drawn and are excluded from composition; they block validation until shown or deleted.

regions.lock.label: Lock region
regions.lock.short: Prevent geometry edits, class changes and deletion of this region until it is unlocked. Locked regions stay in the composition and can be overlapped by new regions.

regions.locked_badge.label: Locked region
regions.locked_badge.short: Locked region — editing disabled. Unlock it to edit or delete.

regions.delete.label: Delete region
regions.delete.short: Delete this region after confirmation. Undo restores it with the same id.

regions.clear_selection.label: Clear selection
regions.clear_selection.short: Deselect all regions without changing them; the brush then starts a new region of the active class.

regions.delete_selected.label: Delete Selected
regions.delete_selected.short: Delete every selected region in one undoable step after confirmation. Locked regions are kept and listed.

regions.split.label: Split
regions.split.short: Separate the disconnected parts of the selected region into their own regions of the same class. One undo restores the original region.

regions.merge.label: Merge checked
regions.merge.short: Merge the selected regions of the same class into one editable region. Refused when classes differ. One undo restores every original region with its id.

regions.subtract.label: Subtract by Order
regions.subtract.short: Remove pixels of higher-priority selected regions from lower-priority selected regions using the current Regions list order, so the selected regions no longer overlap. Non-selected regions are untouched; regions that would become empty need confirmation. Undoable.

regions.duplicate.label: Duplicate
regions.duplicate.short: Copy the selected region directly above it in z-order.

findings.tab.label: Findings
findings.tab.short: Validation and review items: overlaps, missing coverage, hidden regions, class and policy problems. A Finding is never geometry.

findings.validate.label: Validate
findings.validate.short: Recompute Findings for the current annotation revision and store the report that gates export. Does not change any region.

findings.refresh.label: Refresh
findings.refresh.short: Reload the live Findings list from the current canonical state.

findings.filter_status.label: Review filter
findings.filter_status.short: Show all, only unreviewed or only reviewed Findings.

findings.filter_severity.label: Severity filter
findings.filter_severity.short: Show all, only blocking (prevent export) or only warning Findings.

findings.filter_type.label: Type filter
findings.filter_type.short: Show only one Finding type; the list contains the types present in this dataset.

findings.row.label: Finding
findings.row.short: Click navigates the canvas to it and highlights the regions; Ctrl+click toggles, Shift+click selects a range.

findings.severity.label: Severity
findings.severity.short: Blocking Findings prevent export until corrected or, for overlaps, reviewed; warnings are informative.

findings.review_state.label: Review state
findings.review_state.short: Unreviewed overlaps block export; reviewed means you acknowledged the current z-order result. Geometry edits reset the review.

findings.stale.label: Stale validation
findings.stale.short: The stored validation report belongs to an older revision. The list below is live; run Validate to store a current report before export.

findings.select_all.label: Select all visible
findings.select_all.short: Select every Finding matching the current filters.

findings.mark_selected.label: Mark Selected Reviewed
findings.mark_selected.short: Acknowledge the current z-order result of the selected overlaps. Changes review state only; it never subtracts or edits geometry, and blocking non-overlap Findings cannot be waived.

findings.mark_visible.label: Mark All Visible Reviewed
findings.mark_visible.short: Acknowledge every overlap matching the current filters. Review state only, no geometry change.

findings.review_resolved.label: Resolved by order
findings.review_resolved.short: Acknowledge that the region on top is the correct winner. Review state only.

findings.review_intentional.label: Intentional
findings.review_intentional.short: The overlap is intended; z-order decides the final class. Review state only.

findings.boundary_fill.label: Boundary fill
findings.boundary_fill.short: Assign exactly the unlabelled pixels to the Boundary class after confirming the count. Never overwrites a label. Undoable.

view.opacity.label: Overlay opacity
view.opacity.short: Transparency of the region overlays. Display only.

view.brush_radius.label: Brush radius
view.brush_radius.short: Radius of brush and eraser strokes in image pixels.

view.zoom.label: Zoom
view.zoom.short: Magnification of the view. Display only.

view.brightness.label: Brightness
view.brightness.short: Change only the displayed source-image brightness. The original image, annotation data, SAM input, validation and export are unchanged; not saved.

view.contrast.label: Contrast
view.contrast.short: Change only the displayed source-image contrast. Region colours are not affected; nothing is saved or exported.

view.reset.label: Reset View
view.reset.short: Return Brightness and Contrast of the shown channel to neutral (the original rendering).

view.show_overlaps.label: Mark overlaps
view.show_overlaps.short: Hatch pixels covered by more than one region. Display only.

view.show_missing.label: Mark missing pixels
view.show_missing.short: Dot pixels no region covers. Display only.

project.channel_count.label: Images per dataset
project.channel_count.short: How many co-registered source images every dataset carries (1-64). 2 is the classic topography + friction pair. Fixed once the project has datasets.

project.channels.label: Channels
project.channels.short: The project's source channels: label (shown in the UI), key (files, API, export folders) and filename tokens used to pair uploaded files. Editable only while the project has no datasets.

project.channel_label.label: Channel label
project.channel_label.short: Display name of the channel (buttons, navigator, dataset cards, export folder for non-classic channels).

project.channel_key.label: Channel key
project.channel_key.short: Stable machine identifier (lowercase, digits, underscore). Derived from the label for new channels; never changes once saved.

project.channel_tokens.label: Filename tokens
project.channel_tokens.short: Words removed from uploaded filenames to obtain the pairing key, and used by the all-channels picker to sort files (e.g. 'phase, ph').

project.channel_add.label: Add channel
project.channel_add.short: Append another source channel (up to 64). Save to apply.

project.channel_remove.label: Remove channel
project.channel_remove.short: Remove this channel from the draft. At least one channel must remain. Save to apply.

project.channel_save.label: Save channels
project.channel_save.short: Store the channel definitions in the project (new revision). Refused once datasets exist.

import.channel_files.label: Channel files
import.channel_files.short: Select every image of this channel for the batch (TIFF/PNG/JPEG). Files of different channels are grouped by the identifier left after removing the channel tokens.

import.auto_files.label: All channels at once
import.auto_files.short: Select files of every channel together; each file is assigned to the channel whose filename token it contains. Files matching no token are listed and skipped.

replace.channel.label: Channel
replace.channel.short: Which source image of the dataset to replace.

ws.channel.label: Source channel
ws.channel.short: Switch the displayed source image. Annotations, zoom, pan, selection and tool stay; SAM uses the shown channel.

ws.channel_prev.label: Previous channel
ws.channel_prev.short: Show the previous source channel (also Shift+Tab or mouse wheel over the navigator).

ws.channel_next.label: Next channel
ws.channel_next.short: Show the next source channel (also Tab or mouse wheel over the navigator).

ws.channel_slider.label: Channel slider
ws.channel_slider.short: Drag to scrub through the source channels; the image switches while dragging.

ws.channel_index.label: Channel number
ws.channel_index.short: Type a channel number and press Enter to jump to it.

ws.channel_select.label: Channel name
ws.channel_select.short: Pick a source channel by name.

tool.fill.label: Fill enclosed gap
tool.fill.short: Click inside an unlabelled area that is already enclosed by regions: the connected unlabelled pixels become a new region of the active class (and get the optional name). Never changes existing regions.

fill.gap.label: Close gaps (px)
fill.gap.short: Boundaries are thickened by this many pixels before filling, so the fill cannot leak through openings narrower than about twice the value. 0 = exact flood fill.

fill.connectivity.label: Connectivity
fill.connectivity.short: 4-connected ignores diagonal leaks between corner-touching pixels (safer); 8-connected also crosses diagonals.

fill.name.label: Name for filled regions
fill.name.short: Optional region name given to every region the fill tool creates. Leave empty for unnamed regions.

fill.all.label: Fill all enclosed gaps
fill.all.short: Create one region of the active class per enclosed unlabelled area in one transaction, after confirming the count and pixel total. One undo removes them all.

fill.include_border.label: Include border areas
fill.include_border.short: Also fill unlabelled areas that touch the image border; by default only fully enclosed areas are filled.
